name: list-labels
description: Lists the issue labels of the Linear workspace, up to 100, or of one team: each label's id, name and color, and its team's key (null for a workspace label). A label's id goes in the labelIds linear__create-issue and linear__update-issue take.

teamId.description: Narrows the list to one team's labels: a team's id from linear__list-teams.
